# AIB Communications

> AIB Communications (managed by Hopkins TEK Services LLC) is an authorized telecommunications sub-dealer helping customers compare and find available Home Internet, TV, Mobile, and Home Security services across top US providers.

## Core Landing Pages

- [Home Page](https://www.aibcommunications.com/index.html): Compare top home internet, TV, mobile, and home security deals from participating providers.
- [Customer Assistance Desk](https://www.aibcommunications.com/assistance.html): Speak directly with a live agent to compare available plans, check fiber options, and review high bill concerns.
- [Internet Speed Test](https://www.aibcommunications.com/speed-test.html): Run a free connection speed test and compare faster broadband and fiber plans available at your address.
- [Smart Home Security](https://www.aibcommunications.com/home-security.html): Compare professionally monitored security systems, smart automation, cameras, and equipment packages.

## Company & Legal Information

- [Contact Us](https://www.aibcommunications.com/contact.html): Get in touch with our customer service team via phone or email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.aibcommunications.com/privacy.html): Information on how customer data is handled and protected.
- [California Consumer Privacy](https://www.aibcommunications.com/ccpa.html): CCPA privacy rights and state disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.aibcommunications.com/terms.html): Operational disclaimers, authorized sub-dealer terms, and provider availability conditions.
